title: Cheap & over-priced
text: Cheap & over-priced. Cheaply made and the plunger doesn't really work as well as the old red toiet plungers with the long wood handle. The brush it so cheap, I doubt it will last long.  I found a better  plunger/brush combo at Walmart and for a lot less than this one costs. Please take my word and save your money.
